decision: This abort is still useful but the original kill interpretation was too harsh: clean D320/L6 hard-from-start did open PATH prediction at step400, while the matched state_compete_cross scale run was still at path_f1=0.0 through step400. Because the process was killed just after the step400 log, no final eval or loop16 readout exists. Next run should rerun/continue this clean scale long enough to evaluate loop behavior, not expand the complex cross-candidate update.
